prediction.text: As of Chevron's fiscal 2024 10-K (filed February 2025), the Hess acquisition had not closed. The all-stock deal, announced in October 2023 and valued at about $53 billion, had Hess shareholder approval from May 2024. The U.S. antitrust review was also largely resolved. The holdup was the arbitration brought by Exxon Mobil and CNOOC, who claimed a right of first refusal under the Stabroek joint operating agreement in Guyana. They argued that it applied to Chevron's purchase of Hess's 30% stake in the block. Chevron and Hess disputed that claim. The 10-K described the arbitration (ICC proceedings) as unresolved, with a hearing expected in May 2025, and said closing depended on the outcome. I'm not certain of the exact merger-agreement outside date the filing cited. After the filing, the arbitration panel ruled in favor of Hess and Chevron, and the deal closed in July 2025. That outcome is from outside the 10-K.
